verdict.summary_en: Order acknowledgement OA26621446 from Boise Semiconductor Inc. to Soony Interactive GmbH for PO 4500318773 dated 2026-10-26. One line: item 00010, CMP-GAM-001 Game Card 128 GB – Grand Heist 6, 46,000 at 10.93 USD, confirmed for 2026-12-03. Terms are EXW Boise with NET30 payment. The document has no handwritten corrections or stamps.
red_flags: Delivery terms contradict each other: the document says EXW Boise and that DDP is not agreed. It also says freight, insurance and duties are prepaid by the Seller and added to the invoice. Under EXW the buyer normally arranges and pays for freight, so the invoiced freight needs clarifying against Sales Agreement PC-0011-2023 section 4.1.
The document gives no total value, no quantity unit, and no document date.
observations: No handwriting, stamps, signatures or visible damage.
The acknowledgement has no issue date of its own. The only date besides the confirmed delivery date is the PO date 2026-10-26.
